---------------------------------------------------------
Joost : What's on this Week
---------------------------------------------------------

Earth Day: Not Just April 22

We're all environmentally-friendly these days - we have to be. But Earth Day
isn't just about reducing, reusing and recycling - it's about celebrating the
planet. So we've put together a channel that explores the world's greatest
natural wonders, mixed with shows about innovations you can use and steps you
can take to help preserve them.

Watch the Earth Day Channel: http://e.joost.com/I?a=A9X7CquSJjWN8QdNwKb1zqDjZA

---------------------------------------------------------
Featured Videos
---------------------------------------------------------
What is Earth Day: A Short History

Earthling is a term you usually associate with science fiction - but in fact, 
it refers to all of us. And this year, more than a billion of us Earthlings will 
celebrate our planet and make a commitment to protect it on Earth Day. 
We've come a long way since the first Earth Day in 1970.

Watch What is Earth Day: http://e.joost.com/I?a=A9X7CquSJjWN8QdNwKb1zqHjZQ

---------------------------------------------------------

The Future of the Great Barrier Reef

Will the world's largest coral reef system be able to survive coral 
bleaching - "stressful" events that are usually caused by a change in 
water temperature and result in colorless coral? Scientists try to find 
out if coral can adapt to its new environment.

Watch The Future of the Great Barrier Reef: http://e.joost.com/I?a=A9X7CquSJjWN8QdNwKb1zqbjZg

---------------------------------------------------------

Project Greenhouse: 30 Days of Invisible Living

For a full month, your average American male will try to live a 
carbon-neutral life. This means giving up his SUV, burgers and his 
pack-a-day smoking habit for eco-friendly foods, eco-friendly clothes 
and a bicycle. Will he be able to last for the full 30 days?

Watch Project Greenhouse: http://e.joost.com/I?a=A9X7CquSJjWN8QdNwKb1zqfjZw

---------------------------------------------------------

This surfer poet supports environmental causes around
the world. See him perform from a eco-friendly plastic plant. 
Watch Jack Johnson: http://e.joost.com/I?a=A9X7CquSJjWN8QdNwKb1zqTjmA

Watch Hilfiger Sessions: http://e.joost.com/I?a=A9X7CquSJjWN8QdNwKb1zqXjmQ
